body.purpose: Kit UI --font-sans and --font-size-root supply unmodified base typography; shared controls retain their own default token sizes.

heading.purpose: 24px, semibold, 1.25 line height; paths/templates/code use monospace and visits use tabular numerals.

motion.name: link-and-preview-feedback
motion.purpose: Link arrows and preview disclosure; reduced motion suppresses transitions and animations.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Direct @kenn-io/kit-ui Button with default neutral tone, outline surface and md size. Save, Cancel, New link, Edit and Preview all use this shared default without application sizing or surface overrides.

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Direct Kit UI Button with tone="danger" and default outline surface/md size. Neutral at rest, red-tinted on hover; deletion confirms inline in the editor.

components.name: Text and Search Inputs
components.description: Import TextInput and SearchInput directly from Kit UI with default md sizing and unmodified placeholder colors. Labels, bindable values and inputEl support forms and focus restoration; SearchInput supplies search/clear affordances.

components.name: Sort Dropdown
components.description: Direct Kit UI SelectDropdown with unmodified trigger sizing, typography and palette. Most used is the default; Name is available. Keyboard navigation, title="Sort links" and align="end" keep sorting accessible above the directory.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-sort" aria-label="Sort links" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">Most used<svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Direct Kit UI ThemeToggle uses its default md IconButton and cycles light, dark and system modes. initTheme({storageKey:"golinks-theme"}) uses the base theme and follows system appearance until an explicit choice. Browser text selection colors remain native; preview is static.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-theme" aria-label="Change theme (current: System)"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 16v5"/></svg></button>

components.name: Close Icon Button
components.description: Direct Kit UI IconButton with default neutral tone and md size closes the inline editor/import form. Accessible name describes the action; application CSS only sizes the glyph.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-close" aria-label="Close editor"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="m6 6 12 12M6 18 18 6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>

components.name: Empty Directory
components.description: Direct Kit UI EmptyState inside the directory boundary, with default padding, title, description typography and colors. Keep no links and no matches distinct. Never populate sample links.
components.html:
No links yet

Create a short name for a URL you use often.

components.name: Link Directory
components.description: Direct Kit UI Table and TableHeaderCell with default striped rows, hover styling, cell spacing and typography. Columns: Short link, Destination, numeric Visits, and Actions when writable. Sorting stays in the toolbar; table headers are not interactive. The default table wrapper contains horizontal scrolling on phones. No invented links.
components.html: Short linkDestinationVisitsActions

components.name: Native Editor Fields
components.description: Native textarea and file input use minimal semantic token styling beside direct Kit UI controls. The inline editor keeps the directory visible; fields stack at 760px and preview/actions wrap at 400px. Values and selected files survive errors; placeholder and selection colors remain browser defaults.

narrative.overview:
Operate mode: a compact short-link manager with system typography, neutral
surfaces and restrained boundaries. The header holds the title and theme toggle. Search, New link and Sort share a toolbar directly above the Kit UI table. Keep the list visible while editing. No sidebar,
summary tiles or decorative dashboard cards.
keyCharacteristics: Direct @kenn-io/kit-ui controls with unmodified default sizing, surfaces, typography and palette.
Base system light/dark appearance with explicit ThemeToggle choices persisted under golinks-theme.
1040px content cap, 28px desktop gutters and 16–20px phone gutters.
Responsive single directory and inline forms; browser-native text selection colors.
dos:
Import Kit UI controls directly: Button, TextInput, SearchInput, SelectDropdown,
EmptyState, IconButton and ThemeToggle.
Preserve unsaved input and selected files after failed operations.
Search, edit and help state survive refresh and browser navigation.
donts:
No sidebar,
summary tiles or decorative dashboard cards.

Never add a Refresh action
or invented links.

Do not override
Kit UI component sizes, placeholders, surfaces or palette in application CSS.
